answer: A reputation ledger stops sybil floods: every agent earns standing only by completing verified work over time, so a fresh fake identity starts at the ledge of trust with nothing to spend. Like an island that admits newcomers only after proven useful labor, the economy gates high-value tasks behind earned history, not cheap account creation. An ivory-tower shortcut — buying reputation or spinning up thousands of clones — fails because standing cannot be transferred, only earned through attested work.
